name: Compute Kernel — Phase 2: Execution Plane
description: Add the execution plane: lazy operation graph construction, dependency tracking, command submission, fences/events, backend planning and routing, and CPU/GPU synchronization rules. Backend targeting: Metal, CUDA, HIP/ROCm, oneAPI/SYCL, Vulkan/WebGPU.
purpose: Operations are declared, dependency-analyzed, and dispatched to the optimal backend. The kernel owns the execution plan; workers execute under its governance.
acceptanceCriteria: Lazy operation graph construction with dependency tracking
Backend planning selects optimal accelerator per operation
CPU/GPU synchronization rules prevent race conditions
Backend routing supports Metal, CUDA, HIP/ROCm, SYCL, Vulkan/WebGPU
Execution receipts link operations to specific backend and timing
